title: Design: on a phone the reps show under the "Hide Details" toggle
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is a phone screen 390 px wide, and the design pictures "phone-00-b-phone-details.png" (board 6.0) and "phone-02-n6-field.png" (board 6.2) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} is open and not invoiced; its one "Sales Representative" field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • You are on a phone (a touch screen with no mouse pointer) about 390 px wide, and the work order card opens with its fields hidden.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open on the phone.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Tap the details toggle above the work order card.
  2. Compare the screen with the picture of board 6.2.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the toggle reads "Hide Details" and the card shows Lead Technician, Service Advisor and the Sales Representative field.
  • Step 2: as in the picture: "Hide Details" above the card, and "Sales Representative" reading {Sales-rep-A} with the + beside it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 10 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11267 (Story 3, Set the representatives on a phone)

  • S3-R6: “On a phone the work order card opens collapsed, without Lead Technician, Service Advisor or the Sales Representative fields. They show after the card is expanded with its edit button, as Lead Technician and Service Advisor do today. The expand control itself does not change.”

From: Chris Ward's answers, question sheet of 19 Oct 2026, Google Sheet 17Ry1BtRTPEkecBP5TlgAE0T93Ai1TQewdJ7B7WpWDBQ, tab "Questions for Chris", rows 6-43 (answered 19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 9: “9. (a) as the feature spec: the card's existing edit button, unchanged.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 6.0 Before: the details panel today; 6.2 The field on a phone (the attached pictures are these boards).

Where the design and the PRD differ: This is the design's version, held. PRD v10 S3-R6 and Chris Ward's answer 9 say the fields show after the card is expanded with its edit button, and answer 9 rejected "Show Details". Every phone board, today (6.0) and the build (6.2 to 6.7), shows a "Hide Details" toggle above the card and no edit button. Waiting on the product owner: question Q-B in DESIGN-DIVERGENCE-REGISTER.json (drafted 20 Oct 2026, not sent). C665937 follows the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case: phone-00-b-phone-details.png, phone-02-n6-field.png.

  • Design — board 6.0 note: “Production today. On a phone the work order card sits behind the details panel.”
  • Design — board 6.2 title: “6.2 The field on a phone”
  • Design — board 6.2 note: “"Sales Representative" reading "Unassigned", with the + always showing beside it.”
